name: Linen
description:
Plain undyed linen sold as a one-yard square for sewing and household repairs. The weave suits light shirts, towels and bag linings when cut and stitched appropriately.

This is raw cloth, not a finished garment. Thread, tools, patterns and labour are separate; no crafting output or proficiency is granted automatically.
saleUnit: One square yard of plain undyed linen

weight.notes: Three tenths of a pound for one square yard of light linen; a whole bolt is not implied.

name: Canvas
description:
Heavy plain canvas sold in a one-yard square for bags, covers and practical repairs. The untreated fabric is strong but absorbs water until properly treated.

Wax, oil, thread and fittings are separate. This raw piece is not a finished tarpaulin or tent and has no automatic weatherproofing effect.
saleUnit: One square yard of untreated heavy canvas

weight.notes: Six tenths of a pound for one square yard of heavy untreated canvas.

source.title: Devil's Table: Goods & Provisions

name: Wool Cloth
description:
A one-yard square of medium-weight woven wool for making or repairing warm clothing. The edges are left unfinished so a worker can cut to the required pattern.

Thread, tools and labour are separate. It is material stock rather than a finished blanket and grants no protection from cold until put to practical use.
saleUnit: One square yard of woven wool cloth

weight.notes: Half a pound for one square yard of medium-weight wool cloth.

name: Leather
description:
A one-foot square of plain tanned leather for patches, straps and small fittings. Its moderate thickness suits domestic work and ordinary tack repairs.

Buckles, rivets, wax and tools are separate. It is not hardened armour leather or a complete leatherworker's tool set; crafting is handled normally.
saleUnit: One square foot of plain tanned leather

weight.notes: A quarter pound for one square foot of moderate-thickness tanned leather.

name: Iron Bar
description:
A small bar of ordinary wrought iron sold by its one-pound mass for a smith's repair or fitting work. It is unshaped stock with no finished edge or mounting holes.

Heating, fuel, suitable tools and labour are separate. This is neither a finished weapon nor a guarantee of a particular crafting yield.
saleUnit: One one-pound bar of ordinary wrought iron

weight.notes: The full one-pound sold mass is retained; raw metal is not reduced by the adjusted equipment policy.

name: Copper Bar
description:
A one-pound copper bar provides stock for small fittings, vessel repairs and similar metalwork. Its stated mass describes the whole bar rather than a coin denomination.

Tools and workshop labour are separate. Market acceptance and purity are matters for the GM; the Item does not create coins or apply an automatic resale price.
saleUnit: One one-pound bar of ordinary copper

weight.notes: One pound of copper; no hidden bulk package or mass reduction.

name: Salt
description:
Coarse ordinary salt wrapped for kitchen use and practical food preparation. The one-pound packet is convenient to divide into smaller working amounts.

Salt alone is not a day's food or an automatic preservation effect. Ingredients, suitable storage, recipes and labour remain separate; track partial use manually.
saleUnit: One one-pound paper packet of coarse salt

weight.notes: One pound for the filled packet, with light paper packaging absorbed by practical rounding.

name: Beeswax
description:
A plain block of beeswax for treating thread, maintaining suitable surfaces or a craftsperson's wax work. Unlike the sealing Wax entry, it is uncoloured bulk material without prepared seal additives.

Wicks, tools and other ingredients are separate. A block of raw wax is not a candle and has no listed light or burn duration.
saleUnit: One one-pound block of plain beeswax

weight.notes: One pound for the complete block; cut portions require manual inventory tracking.

name: Pitch
description:
A dark block of wood pitch softens with controlled warming for ordinary sealing and repair work. Its stiff paper wrapping keeps it from sticking to other supplies in the pack.

It is not ready lamp fuel, alchemist's fire or a weapon. Application takes appropriate tools and care, and the GM resolves its suitability for a particular surface.
saleUnit: One half-pound wrapped block of wood pitch

weight.notes: Half a pound for the pitch block and light wrapper; warming equipment is separate.

name: Cloth Dye
description:
A small packet of prepared plant-based dye colours compatible cloth when used with water, heat and the usual setting process. The merchant names the available colour at purchase.

Tools, fuel and fixing agents are separate. Colourfastness depends on the cloth and work; it is not a poison, magical disguise or automatic crafting result.
saleUnit: One two-ounce packet of ordinary textile dye

weight.notes: One eighth of a pound for the two-ounce packet; the light wrapper is included.

name: Silk Cloth
description:
A one-yard square of fine plain silk is folded around a clean paper backing for careful storage. Its smooth light weave suits skilled work on delicate linings and decorative garments.

The cloth is uncut material, not a finished luxury garment or climbing rope. Sewing supplies and labour are separate; local supply may depend on a merchant's trading route.
saleUnit: One square yard of plain woven silk

weight.notes: Fifteen hundredths of a pound for one square yard of fine silk and its light backing.
